visual_action: A montage of clips showing large, custom-decorated tractors parked in front of the White House. One tractor is painted with an American flag design, and another is painted gold with signatures on the side. The video then cuts to a shot of Donald Trump, in a suit, signing the side of a large green John Deere combine harvester. The video concludes with a black-and-white logo card for 'THE WHITE HOUSE' over an image of a helicopter.
